info.name: LocalPro Admin API
info.description:
API collection for LocalPro Admin Panel - covering Agencies, Announcements, Bookings, and Activities management endpoints.

## Authentication
All admin endpoints require a Bearer token. Set the `{{auth_token}}` variable after logging in.

## Environment Variables
- `base_url`: API base URL (e.g., https://api.localpro.app)
- `auth_token`: JWT authentication token
